tune::collect_predictions(tuned) else     tune::collect_predictions(tuned, parameters = pars_fin)   prob <- preds[[paste0(".pred_", pos)]]   y    <- as.integer(as.character(preds$class) == pos)   grid <- unique(stats::quantile(prob, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_grid), names = FALSE))   j <- vapply(grid, function(th) {     pred <- prob >= th     mean(pred[y == 1]) + mean(!pred[y == 0]) - 1   }, numeric(1))   stats::median(grid[j >= max(j) - 1e-9]) }  metricas_cv_fold <- function(tuned, pars_fin = NULL, ml_title, threshold = NULL, pos = "presence") {   preds <- if (is.null(pars_fin)) tune::collect_predictions(tuned) else     tune::collect_predictions(tuned, parameters = pars_fin)   id_cols <- intersect(c("id", "id2"), names(preds))   preds |>     dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(id_cols))) |>     dplyr::group_modify(~ {       prob <- .x[[paste0(".pred_", pos)]]       y    <- as.character(.x$class) == pos       auc  <- yardstick::roc_auc_vec(.x$class, prob, event_level = "first")       s05  <- mean(prob[y] >= 0.5); e05 <- mean(prob[!y] < 0.5)       out  <- tibble::tibble(.metric = c("auc", "sens_0.5", "spec_0.5", "TSS_0.5"),                              .estimate = c(auc, s05, e05, s05 + e05 - 1))       if (!is.null(threshold)) {         sy <- mean(prob[y] >= threshold); ey <- mean(prob[!y] < threshold)         out <- dplyr::bind_rows(out, tibble::tibble(           .metric = c("sens_youden", "spec_youden", "TSS_youden"),           .estimate = c(sy, ey, sy + ey - 1)))       }       out     }) |>     dplyr::ungroup() |>     dplyr::mutate(modelo = ml_title, umbral = if (is.null(threshold)) NA_real_ else threshold) }  tuned_models <- list(   "MaxNet"                    = list(tuned = maxnet_tuned,                    = list(tuned = mars_tuned, pars = mars_pars_fin),   "MARS (wdb)"                = list(tuned = mars_tuned_wdb, pars = mars_pars_fin_wdb),   "Naive Bayes"               = list(tuned = nbay_tuned, pars = nbay_pars_fin),   "Naive Bayes (wdb)"         = list(tuned = nbay_tuned_wdb, pars = nbay_pars_fin_wdb),   "KNN"                       = list(tuned = knn_tuned, pars = knn_pars_fin),   "KNN (wdb)"                 = list(tuned = knn_tuned_wdb, pars = knn_pars_fin_wdb),   "Decision Tree"             = list(tuned = dt_tuned, pars = dt_pars_fin),   "Decision Tree (wdb)"       = list(tuned = dt_tuned_wdb, pars = dt_pars_fin_wdb),   "Random Forest"             = list(tuned = rf_tuned, pars = rf_pars_fin),   "Random Forest (wdb)"       = list(tuned = rf_tuned_wdb, pars = rf_pars_fin_wdb),   "LightGBM"                  = list(tuned = lgbm_tuned, pars = lgbm_pars_fin),   "LightGBM (wdb)"            = list(tuned = lgbm_tuned_wdb, pars = lgbm_pars_fin_wdb),   "XGBoost"                   = list(tuned = xgb_tuned, pars = xgb_pars_fin),   "XGBoost (wdb)"             = list(tuned = xgb_tuned_wdb, pars = xgb_pars_fin_wdb),   "MLP"                       = list(tuned = mlp_tuned, pars = mlp_pars_fin),   "MLP (wdb)"                 = list(tuned = mlp_tuned_wdb, pars = mlp_pars_fin_wdb) )  # Un modelo que falle no detiene al resto (queda NA) umbrales <- what: dengueriskcdmx: Data, Rasters and Code for the Dengue Transmission Risk Map of the Mexico City Metropolitan Area — dengueriskcdmx-package
title: dengueriskcdmx: Data, Rasters and Code for the Dengue Transmission Risk Map of the Mexico City Metropolitan Area — dengueriskcdmx-package
text: Data, rasters code supporting dengue transmission risk map Mexico City Metropolitan Area. Includes Aedes aegypti ovitrap presence pseudo-absence data nine environmental socio-demographic predictors (2017-2024, training test partitions), external validation data (2025), study area, Quarto code machine-learning workflow (vignettes). Also provides, 'inst/extdata', rasters (500 m) probability Aedes aegypti occurrence, probability confirmed imported dengue cases, five-level epidemiological risk map, derived consensus (mean probabilities) Random Forest, LightGBM XGBoost models.
